data.title: Gold and silver sink to 14-month lows as hawkish Fed commentary boosts dollar
data.description:
Gold and silver futures fell Wednesday to their lowest levels since September 2025, pressured by a stronger dollar and expectations of further interest rate hikes before year-end by the U.S. Federal Reserve.

Gold dropped more than 3% and broke below $3,750/oz, while silver suffered even larger losses as concerns about industrial demand and tighter financial conditions compounded the selloff.

The release of hawkish minutes from the Fed's October meeting reinforced expectations for additional monetary tightening, indicating the central bank remains firmly committed to raising interest rates to bring inflation down to its 2% target.

The minutes echoed comments from ​Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, who said the Fed needs to "shock people" as prices continue to rise more than he expected by either ⁠approving a 50-basis point rate hike in December or communicating a faster pace of rate increases in 2027.

The dollar strengthened to a fresh 19-month high on Wednesday, as the hawkish commentary and recent economic data solidified expectations for ​a rate hike next month.

"The selloff is being driven by hawkish Fed commentary pointing to the need for several additional rate hikes before spring to contain stubborn inflation, alongside continued dollar strength and real yields at multi-decade highs," Saxo Bank analysts said in a note.

Gold and silver are also getting dragged down in part by the slide in copper (HG1:COM), which plunged more than 5% on Comex to $5.6595/lb, its lowest settlement since April 7.

"Copper is getting hit hard, and the weakness is spilling across the complex," squeezed by worries about AI investment prospects, the Chinese demand outlook, and uncertainty around U.S. trade policy, Phil Flynn of Price Futures Group said.

"A firmer dollar and expectations that interest rates may stay higher are weighing on gold and silver, while momentum selling is adding pressure," Flynn added.

On Wednesday, front-month Comex gold for November delivery plunged 3.1% to $3,736.80/oz, and front-month Comex November silver slumped 4.8% to $44.999/oz, the lowest settlement for the respective metals since September 24 and 25, 2025.

data.title: Ford Starts U.S. Battery Production With CATL Technology
data.description:
DEARBORN (dpa-AFX) - Ford Motor (F) has started producing battery cells at its $3 billion Marshall, Michigan facility, using technology licensed from Chinese battery maker Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. (CATL).

Production began last month, and the first cells are now being shipped for prototypes of Ford's upcoming Fathom electric pickup truck.

This development is a significant milestone in Ford's effort to introduce lower-cost lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries in the U.S., aimed at making electric vehicles more affordable while strengthening domestic battery manufacturing.

Ford said its licensing agreement with CATL will accelerate technology adoption and support the company in building its own production capabilities.

The 2-million-square-foot plant is expected to produce up to 20 gigawatt-hours of battery cells annually, down from the original 40-gigawatt-hour target following adjustments to Ford's EV plans. The facility can manufacture approximately 40 cells per minute.

The project has faced criticism from some U.S. lawmakers and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy over Ford's collaboration with CATL. Ford plans to ramp up production next year, ahead of the Fathom pickup's anticipated launch in the fourth quarter of 2027.

data.title: Moody's Says U.S. Economy Grew More Than Expected
data.description:
By Stephen Nakrosis

The U.S. economy is stronger than initially expected, Moody's Ratings said, with real GDP growth hitting an annualized rate of 3.4% in the third quarter.

In its periodic review of the ratings of the U.S., Moody's, which has the U.S rated at Aa1, said it expects full-year growth of 2.3% this year, before slowing to 2% next year and in 2028.

While AI infrastructure spending is supporting near-term GDP growth and could create longer-term productivity gains, the magnitude of any gains remains uncertain, Moody's added.

Higher interest rates, elevated energy prices and normalization of the AI investment cycle will contribute to slower growth. But U.S. investment and productivity will be supported by the economy's capacity for innovation, dynamic private sector and deep capital markets, according to Moody's.

The stable outlook on the U.S reflects the nation's exceptional credit strengths, which offer resilience to shocks, and the role of the U.S. dollar as global reserve currency.

Moody's also said it expects that the nation will continue its history of very effective monetary policy led by an independent Federal Reserve.

Write to Stephen Nakrosis at stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com

data.title: LIGHT AI ANNOUNCES CORPORATE RESTRUCTURING TO SUPPORT NEXT PHASE OF QUICKSCAN™ DEVELOPMENT
data.description:
Company implements staffing and operating cost reductions of approximately 40% to preserve capital and focus on AI-powered medical device development

VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 18, 2026 /CNW/ -- Light AI Inc. ("Light AI" or the "Company") (Cboe Canada: ALGO) (FSE: 0HC) (OTCQB: OHCFF), a healthcare technology company developing artificial intelligence-powered software-as-a-medical-device ("SaMD") solutions, today announced the implementation of a corporate restructuring designed to reduce operating expenditures, preserve financial resources and align the Company's operations with its ongoing QuickScan™ Strep A development and remediation activities.

The restructuring follows the Company's October 2, 2026, product development update and reflects its continued focus on a disciplined, evidence-based approach to evaluating and advancing its AI-powered medical imaging technology.

Corporate Restructuring and Cash Preservation

As part of the restructuring, Light AI is implementing reductions in staffing and consulting resources, with an anticipated decrease of approximately 40% in monthly operating expenditures, subject to completion of the restructuring process and associated contractual obligations.

These measures are intended to extend the Company's available cash runway while retaining the essential technical, quality assurance, regulatory affairs, engineering and verification and validation ("V&V") capabilities necessary to support its development activities.

The Company's near-term priorities include:

  • Continuing CAPA-7 corrective and preventive action activities, including design-control and quality-system remediation;
  • Evaluating the robustness of its existing machine-learning model and supporting datasets to determine appropriate remediation or redevelopment requirements;
  • Assessing compatible, controlled medical imaging technologies for potential integration with the QuickScan platform;
  • Strengthening design controls, software verification and validation, risk management and supporting quality-system documentation; and
  • Preserving financial resources while evaluating future development, regulatory and strategic opportunities.

"Light AI is undertaking a deliberate operational restructuring to align our resources with the work required to advance our technology responsibly," said John R. Luna, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Light AI.

"Our immediate focus is on preserving the Company's financial resources, retaining the essential expertise required to execute our development and quality remediation activities, and establishing the objective evidence necessary to support future clinical and regulatory decisions. We believe these measures will provide a more focused operating structure for the Company's next phase of development."

Positioning Light AI for the Future

The restructuring represents a transition toward a leaner operating model focused on the Company's core AI and machine-learning capabilities, intellectual property and development of medical imaging applications.

Consistent with its previously announced development priorities, Light AI will continue evaluating its existing technology, including potential ML remediation or redevelopment and alternative imaging approaches, under appropriate design-control and quality-management processes.

The Company will assess subsequent clinical and regulatory activities based on the results of these efforts, available financial resources and applicable regulatory requirements.

Management believes that maintaining financial discipline, strengthening the Company's technical evidence base and focusing resources on defined development priorities will support the Company's evaluation of future opportunities for the QuickScan platform.

Light AI intends to provide further public updates as material developments warrant disclosure in accordance with applicable securities laws.

About Light AI Inc.

Light AI Inc. is a healthcare technology company focused on developing artificial intelligence-powered SaMD solutions designed to support rapid, accessible clinical assessment at the point of care. The Company's core technology, Light AI QuickScan™, is a device-agnostic software platform that applies proprietary artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to medical images to provide healthcare professionals with actionable clinical information within seconds. The QuickScan™ platform is designed to operate across compatible imaging and computing hardware, providing flexibility for integration into a range of healthcare devices, clinical workflows and care settings without dependence on a single proprietary hardware platform.

data.title: Moody's Lowers Nvidia Rating Outlook Following Huang Departure
data.description:
By Katherine Hamilton

Moody's Ratings lowered its ratings outlook for Nvidia to stable from positive following Jensen Huang's exit.

The sudden departure of a key executive without a formal succession plan is the main driver behind the downgrade, the ratings agency said Wednesday. Moody's affirmed Nvidia's Aa1 senior unsecured rating and Prime-1 short-term commercial paper program rating.

Huang's departure has introduced uncertainty about Nvidia's business strategy and financial policies, Moody's said. The change could also have repercussions on Nvidia's growth strategy, as the company addresses potential challenges around governance, operations and export controls.

Further scrutiny from the government might distract management, and increased controls could also ding sales, the ratings agency said.

Moody's is unlikely to upgrade Nvidia in the next 12 to 18 months, even though its financial position remains exceptionally strong, senior vice president Raj Joshi said.

Write to Katherine Hamilton at katherine.hamilton@wsj.com

data.title: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fall in September; China slashes to 2008 low, data show
data.description:
Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in September after edging higher in the previous month, data from the Treasury Department showed on Wednesday, led by declines in holdings from the three largest holders of government debt — Japan, the UK, and China.

Holdings of US Treasuries retreated to $9.241 trillion in September, from $9.317 trillion in August. They hit a record $9.487 trillion in February this year. Compared with a year earlier, Treasuries owned by foreigners were slightly up at 0.3%.

China's holdings in September dropped to the lowest in more than 18 years.

Here are some details:

* Holdings from Japan fell to $1.063 trillion in September, down 0.5% from $1.068 trillion in August. These holdings dropped for a fifth straight month, hitting their lowest since December 2024. Japan, however, remained the largest non-US holder of Treasuries, with holdings hitting a peak of $1.325 trillion in November 2021.

* Holdings from the United Kingdom, the second-largest foreign holder of Treasuries, slid to $985 billion in September, from $994.5 billion the previous month. The UK is widely viewed as a major custody hub for global investors and its flows are often considered a proxy for hedge fund capital.

* China's hoard of Treasuries fell 4.5% to $563.9 billion in September, from $590.7 billion in August, falling for a fourth consecutive month. China's holdings in August were the lowest since July 2008, when these declined to $550 billion.

* China is still the third-largest non-US holder of Treasuries. Its August holdings have fallen by nearly 20% from levels a year earlier.

* On a transaction basis, September saw Treasury inflows of $80.8 billion, down from August's $108.9 billion.

* US corporate bonds also posted inflows of $27 billion in September, compared with $52.3 billion in August.

* US equities continued to show inflows in September, totaling $66.8 billion, from $149.9 billion in the previous month.

* Overall net capital inflows for September increased to $261 billion, up from $203 billion in August.

data.title: Nvidia Bars Huang's CEO Return
data.description:
SANTA CLARA (dpa-AFX) - Nvidia (NVDA) has confirmed that founder Jensen Huang will not return as chief executive, with the board unanimously accepting his resignation and expressing full confidence in interim CEO Colette Kress.

Board Chair Harvey Jones announced the decision during the company's third-quarter earnings call, noting that Nvidia will continue its search for a permanent CEO.

The leadership transition comes amid an investigation into Huang's personal relationships and potential national security concerns.

Huang had previously stated he would be willing to return if the board deemed it in the company's best interest. Nvidia has established a national security and export control oversight committee and plans to strengthen its compliance measures.

Despite the executive changes, Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103 percent year-over-year, with profit rising 105 percent to more than $65 billion, surpassing analysts' expectations. The company projected fourth-quarter revenue of approximately $130 billion, plus or minus 3 percent.

Kress highlighted strong early demand for Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin AI computing technology and raised the fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook to 75 percent, up from the previous forecast of 70 percent.

data.title: RIOT, FLS Stocks Gain As Activist Investor Starboard Sees Undervalued Power And Infrastructure Plays
data.description:
Key points:
  • As per Smith, both companies are now set to benefit from growing demand for power and investment in infrastructure.
  • The firm said Texas-based equipment maker Flowserve’s pumps, valves, and related products place it well to capture reindustrialization spending, including in nuclear power generation.
  • With Riot, approved power projects in Texas, along with a signed lease with Anthropic and longer-term arrangements with Advanced Micro Devices, position the company for the data-center boom, Starboard said.

Shares of Riot Platforms (RIOT) and Flowserve (FLS) advanced on Wednesday after activist investor Starboard Value reportedly outlined further upside for both companies.

According to a Bloomberg News report, citing an investor presentation by Starboard’s Jeff Smith at the 13th Annual Capitalize for Kids Investors Conference in Toronto, the CEO believes that both companies have been undervalued by the market.

As per Smith, both companies are now set to benefit from growing demand for power and investment in infrastructure. While RIOT gained 7% on Wednesday, FLS added 2%

Flowserve’s Industrial Positioning

The firm said Texas-based equipment maker Flowserve’s pumps, valves, and related products place it well to capture reindustrialization spending, including in nuclear power generation. Disruptions in the Middle East that have delayed deliveries could later support new orders for reconstruction and pipeline work. Starboard projected high-single-digit or stronger revenue growth, supported by a record backlog, and operating margins above 22% by 2030 as the start of a longer expansion, Bloomberg said.

In May, Starboard wrote to Flowserve's board urging it to improve operating margins and accelerate revenue growth.

“Flowserve is a great business in a strong industry that has been held back by inconsistent execution. The company trades at a significant discount to peers – even before accounting for Flowserve’s substantial opportunity to improve margins and earnings. With improved performance, we believe the value creation potential at Flowserve is considerable,” Starboard then wrote.

Riot Platforms’ Data-Center Shift

With regard to Riot, Starboard believes approved power projects in Texas, along with a signed lease with Anthropic and longer-term arrangements with Advanced Micro Devices, position the company for the data-center boom, as reported by Bloomberg.

Starboard, in its presentation, described the company’s progress on governance and contracts as significant yet not fully reflected in the market. Anthropic’s IPO, set to price the same day as the presentation, was cited as a potential catalyst for the firm.

The firm estimated that announced deals could generate roughly $2.3 billion in rental income by mid-to-late 2028, with additional value possible through a real estate investment trust conversion or sale to an established data-center operator or infrastructure investor.

Starboard built a significant position in Riot in 2024, when the company was primarily a Bitcoin miner. The activist publicly pushed for converting some of Riot’s existing powered facilities into space for large data-center tenants to capture AI demand.

Earlier this year, in February, the investor wrote to Riot, pressing the company to accelerate its shift from Bitcoin mining to AI/high-performance computing data-center deals, arguing that share price had underperformed peers that secured larger AI/HPC contracts and that “time is of the essence.” It called for a “renewed sense of urgency” to complete more material deals while power markets remained tight.

How Did RIOT, FLS Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around RIOT stock jumped from 'bearish' to 'neutral' territory over the past 24 hours, while message volume stayed at 'normal' levels.

Meanwhile, sentiment around FLS stayed ‘neutral,' accompanied by 'normal' levels of retail chatter.

While RIOT stock has gained 44% year-to-date, FLS has added 17%.

data.title: Florida Flood Relief: 39 U-Haul Stores Now Offering Free Storage
data.description:
Three U-Haul® Companies are offering 30 days of free self-storage and U-Box® container use at 39 stores across South and East Florida to residents impacted by severe flooding.

Torrential rain triggered flash flood warnings across multiple counties on Tuesday, with an estimated 8-10 inches falling in parts of Broward County. Drivers were stranded on Interstate 95 and in flooded shopping plaza parking lots. Many residential and business properties sustained water damage.

Access to self-storage units and portable storage containers is essential to communities when natural disasters strike. U-Haul is ready to help anyone impacted by the flooding who needs a dry, secure storage solution at no cost for one month.

U-Haul Co. of Eastern Florida offered 30 days of free storage to flood victims on Nov. 5. That regional office is extending its offer, while U-Haul Co. of Fort Lauderdale and U-Haul Co. of Miami are joining the disaster relief effort.

The 30 days free offer applies to new self-storage and U-Box rentals and is based on availability. The U-Box offer is for on-site storage at participating facilities; delivery is available for a modest fee.

Please reference the city lists below where U-Haul locations are offering the disaster relief program. Stop by any U-Haul-owned and -operated facility in these cities or call the nearest participating office to arrange a free month of storage.

U-Haul Co. of Eastern Florida

Store locations (12): Boynton Beach, Fort Pierce, Melbourne, Merritt Island, Palm Bay, Palm Beach Gardens, Rockledge, Titusville, West Palm Beach

(561) 638-9428

U-Haul Co. of Miami

Store locations (13): Hialeah, Homestead, Key Largo, Medley, Miami, North Miami, Perrine

(305) 756-4639

U-Haul Co. of Fort Lauderdale

Store locations (14): Coconut Creek, Fort Lauderdale, Margate, Miami Gardens, North Miami Beach, Pompano Beach, Sunrise, West Park, Wilton Manors

(954) 942-1101

In addition to its 30 days free self-storage disaster relief program, U-Haul is proud to be at the forefront of aiding communities in times of need as an official American Red Cross Disaster Responder.

For customers needing storage beyond the free period, the U-Haul 1-Year Price Lock is now available at 2,100 Company-owned facilities across the U.S. and Canada. Fixed-rate storage ensures at least 12 months with no price increase on your rental unit, and U-Haul never charges admin fees or deposits. Learn more at uhaul.com/Storage/1-Year-Price-Lock.

About U-HAUL

Founded in 1945, U-Haul is the No. 1 choice of do-it-yourself movers with more than 25,000 rental locations across all 50 states and 10 Canadian provinces. The U-Haul app makes it easy for customers to use U-Haul Truck Share 24/7 to access trucks anytime through the self-dispatch and -return options on their smartphones with our patented Live Verify technology. Our customers’ patronage has enabled the U-Haul fleet to grow to approximately 205,600 trucks, 137,200 trailers and 44,400 towing devices. U-Haul, which offers rate transparency to self-storage customers through its 1-Year Price Lock, is the third largest storage operator in North America with 1,156,200 rentable storage units and 101.4 million square feet of self-storage space at owned and managed facilities. U-Haul is the top retailer of propane in the U.S. and the largest installer of permanent trailer hitches in the automotive aftermarket industry. For more than 80 years, orange has been an iconic and recognizable color in moving and storage, signifying U-Haul products and services and the quality, affordability, and convenience they provide. Get the U-Haul app from the App Store or Google Play.

data.title: Major law firms boost associates' pay following Cravath, Milbank
data.description:
By Sara Merken

Associates at more major US law firms are getting raises, cementing a new market rate at top firms that ranges from $235,000 for first-year lawyers to $455,000 for senior associates, with additional bonus pay.

Cravath, Swaine & Moore on Tuesday matched rival Milbank’s new associate salary scale while also handing out higher bonuses, according to an internal Cravath memo published by the website Above the Law. The move spurred Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver & Jacobson and Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton to follow suit on Wednesday, according to internal memos viewed by Reuters.

Milbank in June raised associate salaries to a new range starting at $235,000 up to $455,000 based on seniority. The New York firm, which has been a first ​mover among large law firms on associate compensation, in July rolled out so-called special bonuses for associates between $6,000 and $25,000.

Top law firms typically move quickly to match salaries and bonuses to stay competitive. A handful of law firms matched Milbank’s salaries over the summer and in recent weeks, but other major firms, including key ones in New York whose compensation scales are closely ​followed by the ​industry, had not yet announced any changes before this week.

Cravath's special bonuses range from $11,000 to $40,000 based on class year, which exceed Milbank's scale. Year-end bonuses start at $15,000 and go up to $115,000, which is the same that the firm and others have issued in past years. Cravath declined to comment.

Fried Frank and Cleary Gottlieb matched Cravath’s special bonuses as well as the new base salary scale set by Milbank and the now-typical annual bonus figures, according to the firms' internal announcements. The firms declined to comment. Milbank did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Wednesday.
